signal_summary: The earlier ZEC post-liquidation repair has gained a second distinct large exchange-withdrawal accumulator while shielded-pool utilization remains elevated. The signal is accumulation/usage confirmation, not a fresh token-volume breakout.

ecosystem_regime_evidence.note: 7d shielded inflow remains positive but is lower than the +30,462 ZEC observed in the Sep 12 repair scan, so shielded-flow momentum is constructive but decelerating.

evidence: One address accumulated 36.36K ZEC from Binance, OKX, Kraken and Gate over six days; another 6.52K ZEC withdrawal was reported while buying continued.
A second address accumulated about 12.87K ZEC from the same four exchanges over a week and moved about 12.86K ZEC to a fresh wallet on Sep 14.
The roughly 49.23K ZEC observed across the two accumulation paths is about 27 days of estimated 1,800 ZEC/day new issuance.
discretionary_flow_quality.incentive_discount: Exchange withdrawals and shielded-pool net inflow are not points, quests, rebates or yield-farming metrics. No incentive credit is assigned.

leadership_rotation.comment: ZEC is holding the repaired regime after the prior liquidation flush, but current price is below the recent local high and does not qualify as a fresh momentum breakout.

wallet_quality.positive: Two separately observed accumulation paths now exist, and both move ZEC off centralized exchanges rather than into trading venues.
wallet_quality.limitations: Beneficial-owner independence is unproven, both source from the same four exchanges, and neither address has a verified history of selective profitable accumulation. They are not scored as two independent smart-money owners.

narrative_news.positive: Privacy usage is economically native to ZEC: 4.89M ZEC is shielded and 7d net movement into shielded pools remains positive.
narrative_news.risk: ZEC has already risen about 135% over 30 days and privacy/social attention is crowded; influencer/momentum promotion is treated as a risk rather than confirmation.

liquidity_executability.comment: Liquidity is ample for the paper starter. Falling day/day token volume is a caveat and is why this is not a scale-up.

details: ZEC is a native proof-of-work asset, so honeypot, contract mint/freeze, creator-controlled LP and deployer privilege gates do not apply as they do to smart-contract launch tokens.
Maximum supply is 21M ZEC; circulating supply is about 16.93M and current issuance is estimated near 1,800 ZEC/day.
Shielded balances improve privacy but make beneficial-owner concentration harder to audit; this remains a structural-data limitation rather than a discovered hard failure.

major_uncertainties: The two whale paths may be related or controlled by one beneficial owner.
No verified historical selectivity/PnL record exists for the accumulator addresses.
Shielded 7d inflow is positive but slower than at the Sep 12 repair checkpoint.
Current ZEC trading volume is down about 38.7% from the previous day; the signal is not a volume acceleration.
Recent institutional/ETF AUM evidence is not fresh enough to be treated as a new flow leg.
The asset has already had an extreme multi-month run, increasing crowding and reversal risk.
why_signal_matters_now: The Sep 12 repair signal lacked a credible new accumulation cohort. A second distinct exchange-withdrawal accumulator was subsequently observed, while the first path and shielded-pool usage remained visible. This is enough for a prospective starter now, at the current mark, without taking credit for the prior rally.

paper_trade.sizing: 2.5% of pre-trade NAV; no scale-up because wallet independence, volume momentum and crowding remain unresolved.
